title: Adefunkeee Salon — Frontal Wigs, Styling & Nails, Lekki
description: Lagos hairstyling salon in Lekki Phase 1. Frontal installs, sleek ponytails, styling and nails. Book your slot online.

hero.headlineHtml: A good hair day starts from here.
hero.text: Seamless frontal installs, sleek ponytails and styling that lasts, plus nails while you're in the chair. Book your slot below instead of sending a DM.

main.alt: Sleek straight frontal install at Adefunkeee Salon

items.title: Frontal install
items.text: Clean, flat, melted lace that looks like it grew there.

items.title: Frontal ponytail
items.text: Sleek ponytails with laid edges, swoop or bangs.

items.title: Curls & styling
items.text: Bouncy curls, waves and revamps for your existing units.

items.title: Colour & revamp

feature.title: Buy the wig, book the install
feature.text: Our wigs come from @hairbyadefunkeee. On the live site, customers buy a unit and book the install together. They pay once and the stylist knows exactly what's coming.
feature.ctaMsg: On the live site this opens the wig shop with an 'add install' option at checkout.

booking.title: Book your slot
booking.text: Pick your service, day and time and we'll confirm on WhatsApp. Our policy is shown before you book, so there are no surprises.
terms: 10a Kafayat Abdulrazaaq Street, off Fola Osibo, Lekki Phase 1.
WhatsApp 0818 395 7348 to book. Walk-ins are welcome.
A deposit secures your slot. Lateness over 30 minutes may be rescheduled.
booking.termsNote: Deposit and lateness terms are samples. The live site would show Adefunkeee's own Policy highlight.
